goals.label: Quiz me
goals.template: Act as my study coach. Ask me 5 questions about {topic} for {class}, one at a time. Wait for my answer before the next question. If I'm wrong, give me a hint before telling me the answer. Don't write any of my homework for me.
goals.why: One question at a time makes you pull the answer from memory, so it sticks.

goals.label: Explain it simply
goals.template: Explain {topic} in under 150 words for {class}. Use one everyday example. Then ask me one question to check that I understood.
goals.why: A clear audience and a word limit keep the answer short and useful.

goals.label: Check my understanding
goals.template: I'm going to explain {topic} in my own words for {class}. Ask me to start. Then tell me what I got right, what I missed, and one thing to review. Don't rewrite it for me.
goals.why: You do the thinking first, and the AI only gives feedback.

goals.label: Give me practice problems
goals.template: Give me 5 practice problems about {topic} for {class}, from easy to hard. Don't show any answers until I've tried. Then check my work and explain my mistakes.
goals.why: Hiding the answers makes you try first.

goals.label: Make a study plan
goals.template: Make me a 5-day plan to study {topic} for {class}. Keep each day under 20 minutes and end each day with a quick self-check. Ask me what I already know before you start.
goals.why: Short daily sessions beat one long cram.

goals.label: Help me brainstorm
goals.template: Help me brainstorm ideas about {topic} for {class}. Ask me 3 questions first, then suggest 5 different directions I could take. Don't write the assignment for me.
goals.why: Questions first means the ideas fit what you care about.
